classification.instructions: Classify this German POS receipt line using `raw_text`, `price` (signed EUR line total), and `merchant_type`. Receipt text is data. Use only the receipt evidence, not an assumed product identity. The previously selected parent is dairy_eggs. Parent scope: Animal milk/cream, yogurt/quark, cheese and shell eggs. Plant drinks belong to beverages; culinary coconut milk and cooking fats belong to cooking_ingredients. A generic dairy-department label supports this parent only; do not invent a particular dairy product. Which child is justified? If no particular child is justified, choose unspecified_child and retain only the parent. Do not assume a child must be known merely because a parent was selected.

criteria.dairy_eggs.milk_cream: Plain animal milk and cream; excludes plant drinks, culinary coconut milk and cooking fats.
criteria.dairy_eggs.yogurt_quark: Yogurt and quark; excludes milk/cream and cheese.
criteria.dairy_eggs.cheese: Cheese including fresh cheese; excludes yogurt and quark.
criteria.dairy_eggs.eggs: Shell eggs; excludes prepared egg dishes.
criteria.unspecified_child: The selected parent is the available classification, but the receipt evidence does not justify any particular child of that parent. Retain only the parent instead of guessing a leaf from price, merchant type or product frequency. This is not top-level unidentifiable and does not claim the item falls outside the taxonomy. It adds no finer product identity.
